segments.ja361:1.3: Subāhu na mayā seyyo, sudāṭha iti bhāsasi.
segments.ja361:2.3: Sudāṭho na mayā seyyo, subāhu iti bhāsasi.
segments.ja361:3.1: Evaṃ ce maṃ viharantaṃ, subāhu samma dubbhasi;
segments.ja361:4.1: Yo paresaṃ vacanāni, saddaheyya [saddahetha (sī. syā. pī.)] yathātathaṃ;
segments.ja361:4.3: Khippaṃ bhijjetha mittasmiṃ, verañca pasave bahuṃ.
segments.ja361:5.1: Na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhedāsaṅkī randhamevānupassī;
segments.ja361:5.3: Yasmiñca setī urasīva putto, sa ve mitto yo abhejjo parehīti.
